review_scope: Narrow independent pre-fit review of the held-out residual-scale experiment for raw batch2+4 development assets. No model invocation, fitting, test access, raw-cycle reread, or shared-state/lock change was performed.

checks.feature_boundary_assessment: The inspected feature sample and runner enforce a prefix cutoff through each origin; the feature-builder computation was outside the permitted review scope, so its internal slope calculation was not independently rederived.

scaler.assessment: No scaler or normalization is fitted or applied by this runner; the model receives cycle age, SOH, and rate20 directly.

two_arm_comparison.arm_A: equal-cell RMS log-residual scale estimated on fit cells
two_arm_comparison.arm_B: equal-cell RMS log-residual scale estimated on held-out calibration cells

case_equal_metrics_and_frozen_gate.primary_shared_point_metric: mean absolute error of exp(mu_log_RUL) over origins, case-equal

scope_limits: This is a development comparison using the already exposed 18 dev cells; it is not independent confirmation, a paper innovation claim, a formal reproduction, or evidence of natural-censoring benefit.
Physical serial identity and full-source SHA are not verified; cohort isolation is by source batch/index only.
No raw cycle data were reread; only manifest role/field metadata and two leading feature rows from one feature file were inspected.
repair_required: Create a fresh ROOT_GO.json bound to the three reviewed hashes and the one-CPU-fit/two-scalar-estimate budget before any run; do not reuse the old consumed GO.
